description: book a vet visit for my pet
utterances: my cat has been sneezing for days can she come in
Our dog has been limping on his back leg since the weekend and it isn't getting better, I'd like to bring him in to be looked at this week.

description: move my pet's vet visit to another time
utterances: cant make tuesday for the dog, got anything on thursday instead
My rabbit is booked in for a checkup on Saturday morning but I have to work that day now, could we shift it to a weekday evening?

description: cancel my pet's upcoming vet visit
utterances: scrap the appointment for my dog tomorrow, hes fine now
The lump on my cat's side turned out to be a bite that's already healing, so we won't need the slot on Friday afternoon anymore, please free it up.

description: get my pet seen today without an appointment
utterances: my dog ate something weird and is throwing up, can you fit him in now
I don't have anything booked but my cat hasn't eaten since yesterday and is hiding under the bed, is there any way a vet could squeeze her in today?

description: find out where to take my pet after closing time
utterances: its almost midnight and my dog cant breathe right, where do i go
Your clinic is closed for the long weekend and my cat just got hit by a car, which emergency hospital do you partner with and are they open right now?

description: schedule vaccine shots for my pet
utterances: puppy needs his first jabs, when can we come
We just adopted a kitten from the shelter and they said she still needs her second round of injections, I'd like to arrange that with you soon.

description: find out when my pet's next booster is due
utterances: is my dogs yearly shot overdue, i lost track
I can't remember whether my cat had her annual injection last autumn or the one before, could you check and tell me when the next one is needed?

description: get written proof that my pet is vaccinated
utterances: the kennel wants a paper showing my dog had his shots
I'm signing my dog up for agility classes and the trainer requires an official record from the vet listing every injection he has received and the dates.

description: get the paperwork to take my pet abroad
utterances: taking my cat overseas next month what documents do i need from you
We're relocating to another country with our dog and the authorities there require a signed health form from a vet issued within ten days of departure.

description: reorder my pet's regular medication
utterances: almost out of my dogs heart tablets, need another box
My cat has been on the same thyroid pills for two years and the last bottle is nearly empty, can you prepare another month's supply for me to collect?

description: buy more flea and worm treatment for my pet
utterances: need the monthly tick drops for both cats again
Tick season is starting and I want to stock up on the spot-on preventative my dog uses, do you have his weight on file to get the right size pack?

description: my pet is reacting badly to a medication
utterances: the new pills make my dog vomit every time, someone needs to look at this
Since we started the antibiotics you gave us our cat has been lethargic and had diarrhea, I'd like the vet to tell us whether to stop giving them.

description: get the results of my pet's tests
utterances: did the bloodwork for my cat come back yet
The vet took a urine sample and blood last week and said the lab would take a few days, could you let me know what came back?

description: talk to the vet about what my pet's results mean
utterances: got the report for my dog but its all numbers, can the vet call me
The kidney panel for my elderly cat came through yesterday with several values marked high and I'd like a proper conversation with the vet about what we do next.

description: schedule desexing surgery for my pet
utterances: want to get my kitten fixed, how soon can it be done
Our male puppy is about six months old now and we'd like to have him neutered before he starts marking everywhere, what dates do you have for the operation?

description: book a teeth cleaning for my pet
utterances: my dogs breath is awful, can you do a proper scale and polish
At the last checkup the vet mentioned my cat has heavy tartar and should have her mouth cleaned under anaesthetic, I'd like to go ahead and set that up.

description: have a microchip implanted in my pet
utterances: can you chip my new puppy while hes in for his shots
We adopted an older cat who was never chipped by her previous owners, I'd like to get that done so she can be identified if she ever wanders off.

description: change the contact details linked to my pet's microchip
utterances: we moved house, the chip still has our old info on it
I took over my late father's dog and the chip is still registered under his name and phone number, how do I get the registry changed over to me?

description: book a follow up visit after my pet's operation
utterances: my dog had his op last week, when do the stitches come out
Our cat was spayed ten days ago and the discharge sheet said to bring her back for a wound check, I'd like to arrange that for sometime this week.

description: find out how much a procedure will cost
utterances: roughly what would it run me to have a lump removed from my dog
The vet recommended surgery on my cat's knee and before I decide I need a written breakdown of what the thing is likely to add up to, including aftercare.

description: reserve a boarding place for my pet while i am away
utterances: going away for ten days in august, can you take my two cats
We have a wedding out of town over the holidays and need somewhere safe for our dog to stay for five nights, do you have space in your kennels?

description: keep my pet in boarding longer than booked
utterances: my trip got extended, can the dog stay two more nights
I was supposed to collect my cats on Sunday but I'm stuck abroad until Wednesday, is it possible for them to remain with you until then?

description: pass on feeding and medication instructions for my pet's stay
utterances: my dog needs his tablets twice a day while hes with you, who do i tell
Before I drop my cat off next week I want to make sure whoever looks after her knows she only eats the prescription kidney food.

description: get an update on how my pet is doing while boarded
utterances: hows my dog settling in, is he eating ok
It's the first time our cat has been away from us and I'm anxious, could someone send me a quick message or photo to let me know she's coping?

description: enroll my dog in daytime care
utterances: can my dog come hang out with you during the day while im at work
I've just gone back to the office and my young lab gets destructive when left alone, I'd like to sign him up for weekday drop off and pick up.

description: get my pet a full wash and haircut
utterances: my poodle is a matted mess, need the works done on her
Our long haired cat sheds everywhere and hates being brushed at home, I'd like to book her in for a proper bath, brush out and trim with your groomer.

description: book just a nail trim for my pet
utterances: just need his claws clipped, nothing else
My dog's nails are clicking on the floor but he doesn't need a bath or haircut, can I bring him by for a quick clip without the full package?

description: the groomer did a bad job on my pet
utterances: you shaved my dog way shorter than i asked and he has a nick on his ear
When I picked my cat up from her session yesterday she had a raw patch on her belly and her fur was uneven, I want to know what happened.

description: have my pet's records forwarded to another vet
utterances: were moving so can you send my dogs history to the new clinic
I've registered my cat with a practice closer to our new home and they've asked for her full vaccination and treatment history to be passed on to them.

description: understand the charges on my vet bill
utterances: why is the bill for my cats visit double what you quoted
The invoice from my dog's overnight stay has a lot of separate lines I don't recognize, including something called a hospitalisation fee, could someone go through it with me?

description: register a new pet with the clinic
utterances: just got a puppy, how do i add him to your books
We've taken in a stray cat and want her to become a regular patient here, what details do you need from us to set that up?

description: have the vet fill in my pet insurance claim
utterances: can the vet sign my insurance form for the surgery
My pet policy requires the treating clinic to complete their section of the claim and attach the clinical notes before I can submit it, how long does that take?
